result.title: GUI-PRISM: Efficient Action Decoding for GUI Agents
result.summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate screenshots and user instructions into executable actions. Most existing approaches rely on vision-language models to generate actions as text, often leading to substantial inference latency due to autoregressive decoding. To address this inefficiency, we propose GUI-PRISM, a hybrid action decoder that directly predicts action types and structured arguments while retaining language generation for open-ended text. Unlike existing spatial decoding methods that primarily focus on target localization, GUI-PRISM extends direct prediction to action types and their associated arguments, enabling complete GUI action prediction. Specifically, GUI-PRISM employs field-specific queries to extract action-relevant semantic and spatial information from a shared multimodal feature bank. It further models dependencies among action components through conditional queries. Gated residual cross-attention refines these predictions using fine-grained multimodal information. GUI-PRISM achieves 95.1\% accuracy on ScreenSpot-v2, outperforming the strongest head-based spatial decoding method by 2.0 percentage points while delivering a 3.8$\times$ inference speedup over the baseline. On AndroidControl-v2 and MM-Mind2Web-v2, it improves complete-action accuracy by 4.8 and 0.7 percentage points while achieving 2.7$\times$ and 3.9$\times$ inference speedups over the baseline, respectively. Our code is available on our project page.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GUI-PRISM，用混合动作解码器替代纯文本自回归输出：以字段特定查询从共享多模态特征库中抽取语义与空间信息，并通过条件查询建模动作类型与参数间的依赖，结合门控残差交叉注意力直接预测结构化动作，而开放式文本仍由语言生成完成。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向 GUI 动作解码效率而非 latent 推理，但其「以查询从多模态特征中并行预测结构化动作组件、并用条件依赖建模」的解码结构，可供核查能否用于非自回归地生成结构化中间状态或并行推理轨迹。
